title: THE BACKWARD DIGEST · 1997 over 2027
venue: private · after the print tech's misfold of Sept 30, 1999 · Box 23 onward
logline: The first strip's cafeteria panel drawn in the 1997 xerox line and, printed over it in the private washes at the same scale, the same cafeteria's lit windows from the beach road in 2017's Twenty Years — two drawings on one sheet, thirty years apart, the tables of one showing through the windows of the other. Neither is on top.

panels.composition: Two drawings overlaid on one sheet at the same scale: a school cafeteria interior in harsh xerox black and white with a four-panel grid faint, and over it in muted washes the same cafeteria's lit windows seen from a road at dusk, the tables of the first visible through the windows of the second, neither drawing dominant.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, two drawings overlaid on one sheet at the same scale, a school cafeteria interior in harsh xerox black and white with a faint four-panel grid and over it in muted washes the same cafeteria's lit windows seen from outside at dusk, neither on top, no words legible
image.notes: Canon: dw_1997-09-12 (#1) and dw_2017-09-17. The overlay is the device; no other page uses it.

art.line: the private line, turned: mirrored, overlaid, folded
art.palette: the private washes; the 1997 xerox black where 1997 is quoted
art.paper: Arches; one page on a printed misfold
